description: Read one owner-authorized Dev or Prod database query (at most 100 rows, five-second timeout). Explicitly choose the environment. Shared data resolves to the same physical database. Application RLS policies apply; use an authorized SQL export when a full archive is required.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_query
